01About

From IBM hardware to network and cloud

I am completing a Foundation Degree in Computing (Level 5) in November 2026 and I am looking for a first- or second-line network or infrastructure support role, with a path into cloud (AWS).

I started at IBM in 2000, giving 24/7 hardware and systems support to banking, government and energy clients. I then founded an internet service provider on Cisco and Linux with 15 staff and over 500 subscribers. Later I led sales, technical design and ISO certification for a Daikin authorised distributor. Since 2019 I have driven HGVs in the UK and studied computing alongside night shifts.
